sections.heading: Problem
paragraphs: Customer exports sorted only by a timestamp can skip a row when multiple readings share the same timestamp. Reproduced on a sandbox export containing 260 readings at the same second.

sections.heading: Proposal
paragraphs: Use observed_at plus a stable reading ID as the ordering pair and encode both in the opaque cursor. Keep the public response contract. Readers continue to support previously issued cursors during a two-week transition.

sections.heading: Acceptance
paragraphs: A pagination test must return every row exactly once while the dataset is unchanged. The owner will compare row counts across page sizes of 100 and 250.
